description: A cobblemon side-mon that adds a new villager profession who trades for Fossils and restoration machine parts

releases.notes:
# Changes
- Added wood variants to the lab tables
  - Spruce
  - Birch
  - Jungle
  - Acacia
  - Dark Oak
  - Mangrove
  - Cherry
  - Bamboo
  - Warped
  - Crimson
  - Apricorn
- New Chisel item
  - Iron
  - Diamond
- New Concretion item
- Item displaying, right click the lab table with an item to use it as a display
- Concretion Processing, accessed by shift right clicking a lab table, turning concretions found in fossil structures into a random one of a type of pokemon fossil, crystals (amethysts,diamonds,emeralds), bone (bone,bonemeal), and or one of the types of tumblestones
- Updates to research labs village structures
  - Taiga
  - Plains
  - Desert
- Updated Lab table recipe to reflect the ability to craft with other wood types
